spec.comparator_definition: compatible-set majority: predict 1 iff #{M in V(D): q(M)} > |V(D)|/2, computed with exact integer counts (versionspace.exact_posterior)
spec.empty_version_space_rule: missing predictions score 0 for both methods (realizable worlds cannot produce an empty V(D)); complete-case sensitivity reported

historical_secondary.note: expected accuracy of a uniformly random compatible model; registered v1 primary, retained as secondary

spec.interval: stratified paired cluster bootstrap over worlds, percentile, two-sided 95%
spec.question: superiority (two-sided); magnitude reported against the 0.05 substantive reference; no equivalence claim

required_null.sampling: IID uniform over the complete class H(n=7,k<=3) per node; no rejection of development overlaps (audited only)

spec.status: prospective primary proposed for review (amended after development inspection, before any confirmation; Codex R1 decision)
spec.terminal_rule: every planned world must have a terminal ok result; unresolved whole-world failures make the primary incomplete (bounded missing-outcome sensitivity reported, no planned-N claim)
spec.world_score: mean over the world's 16 intervention queries of correct(a) - correct(b)

mc_diagnostic.policy: primary comparator uses the EXACT integer-count posterior; MC is not used. The diagnostic quantifies what a finite-sample MC majority (as in v1) would have changed.

null_overlap_audit.rule: IID null draws retained; overlap audited and reported only

semantics_changed_from_v1: primary contrast index - vs_majority (v1: index - uniform)
exact integer-count posterior (v1: Monte Carlo for large multistep version spaces)
exogenous design s2-design-v2 (v1: holdouts and query redraws depended on hidden trajectories)
strict plan reconciliation and failure accounting (v1: concatenated records, failures ignored)

stress_descriptive.note: descriptive; noisy two-part MDL is computed for every selection code under the identical residual code and budget, so index-specific robustness is assessed against matched codes
